annotations.text:
Four screens organised around a decision, not a CLI verb. None of them exist in the current dashboard.

Index trust (#88, #100) — how much of what ran can atlas actually see. No comparable tool reports its own blind spot.
Change (#89) — patch coverage for the diff, as a gate. Codecov's patch status, but scoped to features.
Hotspots (#93) — churn x gap, CodeScene's idea at feature granularity.
Affected (#90) — the minimal test set for a diff, with an honest fallback when a changed file is not indexed.

The eight pages specced in docs/GUI_WIREFRAMES.md, rebuilt on the SQLite model (packages/store) instead of the YAML registry the current internal/server reads.

Tokens are lifted from the implemented app — internal/server/templates/base.html (Material-3 dark) and static/style.css — not from the GitHub palette in the wireframes doc, which the implementation has already moved away from.

Two additions carry the #85 lesson into these screens: Overview ends with an attribution caveat, and Diff separates raw delta from like-for-like delta.
